body_html:
Great event with no issues. Was setup almost an hour before start time. Everyone seemed very please and enjoyed themselves.”,”Terrace Gardens down in Ken Caryl is such a beautiful wedding venue. Today we were lucky enough to be a part of another wedding ceremony and reception down there, and despite the heat during the outdoor ceremony, it was amazing and well worth it. After everyone got inside and cooled off though it was dancing time! This group loved to dance and there was no slowing down until the very last song! Certainly another great wedding put on by JAMMIN’ DJs and DJ Cameron!

DJ Cam
